title: Agreement Without Alignment: Label-Free Rubric Clarification Increases LLM-Judge Consensus but Not Agreement with Humans
abstract: arXiv:2610.13303v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM judges are increasingly deployed as panels, and disagreement among panel members is often read as a symptom of an unclear rubric. We test a label-free procedure that turns this disagreement into rubric repairs. The procedure decomposes each rubric into sub-criteria, ranks them by cross-judge disagreement on a development split, and has an editor model rewrite only the most contested ones. An additional stage that moves text-checkable sub-criteria to deterministic checkers transferred none in our evaluation. Human labels are never used to select or edit clauses; they are used only to evaluate the outcome. We pre-specified four hypotheses in a version-controlled protocol and evaluated six rubric conditions with a panel of five judges from three providers on SummEval, the HealthBench meta-evaluation, and USR Topical-Chat, for a total of 129,770 judge requests, excluding retries. translated_title: 无需对齐的一致性：无标签的评分标准澄清提升了LLM裁判间的共识，却未提升与人类评判的一致性
translated_abstract: LLM裁判越来越多地以评审团的形式部署，而评审团成员之间的分歧通常被解读为评分标准不清晰的征兆。我们测试了一种无标签的程序，将这种分歧转化为评分标准的修复。该程序将每个评分标准分解为子标准，根据在开发集上裁判间的分歧程度对子标准进行排序，并让一个编辑模型仅重写争议最大的子标准。在我们的评估中，将可文本检查的子标准迁移至确定性检查器的附加阶段没有迁移任何子标准。人类标签从不用于选择或编辑条款；它们仅用于评估结果。我们在一个版本控制的协议中预先指定了四个假设，并使用来自三个提供商的五名裁判组成的评审团，在SummEval、HealthBench元评估和USR Topical-Chat上评估了六种评分标准条件，总计进行了129,770次裁判请求（不含重试）。在SummEval上，该程序提高了裁判间的Krippendorff alpha系数……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种无标签的评分标准澄清程序，通过将裁判间分歧转化为对争议子标准的重写修复，显著提升了LLM评审团内部的一致性，但发现这种共识的提升并不能转化为与人类评判更高的一致性。
en_tdlr: A label-free rubric clarification procedure that repairs the most contested sub-criteria based on cross-judge disagreement increases consensus within LLM judge panels, but this improved judge agreement does not translate into better alignment with human judgments.
